note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Conapto Stockholm 5 North (STHLM 5 Nord), new 28 MW IT data centre in Edsberg, Sollentuna, next to Conapto Stockholm 3 North (Bäckvägen 18) - Conapto Stockholm North Campus (new site)
entries.reason: Status evidence is in hand but no allowed official locator exists. (1) Sollentuna municipality's page 'Arbeten på och kring Bäckvägen 2026-2028' (www.sollentuna.se/backvagen, local sollentuna-backvagen.html, page stamp 'Sidan uppdaterades 3 september 2026', sitemap lastmod 2026-09-03) lists 'Datacenter - Conapto: Utbyggnad pågår 2026-2027' and closes Bäckvägen to through traffic during the construction; no Internet Archive copy exists (CDX empty), so the stamp is not bounded and the text may predate the window. (2) Conapto's Swedish construction page (sv/support/bygginformation, local conapto-sv-support-bygginformation.html; datePublished 15 June 2026, dateModified 30 September 2026, unbounded; the only archive copy is of 11 July 2026) says Conapto is building a new data centre in Sollentuna directly adjoining Stockholm 3 Nord, 'Bygget har inletts', completion summer 2027, and lists piling and groundworks July-October. (3) Conapto Group Holding II AB's Q2 2026 report (published 28 August 2026, local conapto-q2-2026-report.pdf) says the development of Stockholm 5 Nord progressed according to plan, fully contracted (28 MW), operations scheduled for July 2027 (period end 30 June 2026, outside the window). Addresses come from the May 2026 bond prospectus (local conapto-prospectus-2026-05.pdf): Stockholm 3 North at Bäckvägen 18, 192 54 Sollentuna; Stockholm 2 South at Stensätravägen 13 and Stockholm 4 South at Stensätravägen 6, 127 39 Skärholmen; Stockholm 1 City at Sandhamnsgatan 63B. No permitted host publishes an address point or property geometry for Bäckvägen 18: Lantmäteriet's address and property products redirect to the login-only Geotorget; Sollentuna's property and plan feature services sit on services6.arcgis.com, whose robots.txt answered HTTP 403 (see compliance.log); Conapto's pages publish no map coordinates; OpenStreetMap services are disallowed.
entries.reopen_condition: An allowed official locator for Conapto Stockholm 3/5 North (a Sollentuna or Länsstyrelsen record giving the property designation with geometry or coordinates, a building-permit or environmental-permit document with coordinates, or a Conapto-published map point), read while a dated in-window construction statement exists (for example an archived copy bounding the Sollentuna or Conapto construction page, or Conapto's Q3 2026 report due in week 48 of 2026); then admit Stockholm 5 North as under construction on the North Campus as a new site.

entries.candidate: Conapto Stockholm South Campus (Stockholm 2 South, Stensätravägen 13, and Stockholm 4 South, Stensätravägen 6, Skärholmen; property Stockholm Stensätra 19, Sätra industrial area) - operating campus not in the Atlas
entries.reason: Länsstyrelsen Stockholm's notice of 26 August 2026 (local lst-page-47.html; Miljöfarlig verksamhet, Stockholms kommun, dnr 18858-2026) says Conapto AB has applied to the county Environmental Assessment Delegation for a permit for a reserve-power plant of 108 MW total installed input power on property Stockholm Stensätra 19 in the Sätra industrial area: a dated government record, but of an application for an ancillary permit, not of the data centre's status. The last dated operating statements for Stockholm 4 South are outside the window: CoreWeave's release of 24 June 2026 ('initial capacity already online at Stockholm 4 South') and the Q2 2026 report (period end 30 June 2026; the Stockholm 4 Syd expansion became operational). Conapto's posts of 26 August and 23 October 2026 name no facility, and its facility pages are undated. No allowed official locator for the Stensätravägen addresses was found (Lantmäteriet services require Geotorget login; Stockholm city's open-data portal was unreachable).
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Conapto, customer or authority statement of the South Campus's current operation or works, plus an allowed official address point or property geometry for Stensätravägen 6/13 or Stensätra 19.

entries.candidate: Conapto Stockholm 1 City (Sandhamnsgatan 63B, Stockholm) and Stockholm 3 North (Bäckvägen 18, Sollentuna) existing operations, plus the Stockholm 3 North 1.2 MW capacity expansion
entries.reason: Both facilities are listed as existing data centres in Conapto's May 2026 bond prospectus (outside the window), and the Q2 2026 report (period end 30 June 2026) says the expansion of Stockholm 3 Nord commenced in the quarter; no in-window dated statement names either facility's current status, the facility pages are undated, and no allowed locator was found (see the Stockholm 5 North hold). Sandhamnsgatan 63A/63B is also Conapto's head-office address, which cannot serve as a locator without a facility-specific official point.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Conapto or authority record naming Stockholm 1 City or Stockholm 3 North with a current status, plus an allowed official facility locator.

entries.candidate: Nova Complex Oy data-centre project, Loviisa (about 6 ha leased for phase 1 of three)
entries.reason: The City of Loviisa reported on 22 January 2026 (local loviisa-kaupunginvaltuusto-hyvaksyi-maanvuokrasopimuksen-nova-complex-oy-...html) that the city council approved on 21 January 2026 a land lease and preliminary sale agreement with Nova Complex Oy for about 6 ha for the first phase of a three-phase data-centre project, and that the zoning plan for the next phase would go to decision-makers in winter. This is outside the 85-day window. The city's post sitemap (to 26 October 2026), plan pages and the 200 most recent meeting items in its Dynasty feed (to the 29 October 2026 technical board agenda) contain no later Nova Complex item; the 19 August 2026 council plan changes concern other areas (Valko harbour west, Köpbacka). The leased plot is not identified, so no locator exists.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Loviisa or Nova Complex record (plan approval, building permit, works) that identifies the plot or property; Ryhti can then supply a building point.

entries.candidate: Brookfield AI center, Strängnäs (existing record imported:semiconductor-atlas:brookfield-strangnas): status refresh checked
entries.reason: Strängnäs municipality's Görsingeberget establishment-area page (local strangnas-gorsingeberget.html) is stamped 'Senast uppdaterad: 17 september 2026' and says the municipality has agreed to sell land to Brookfield for an AI centre in the long term, that Brookfield has two years to secure grid capacity, and that the project is at an early stage with no building permits applied for. A diff against the Internet Archive copy of 8 May 2026 (local wb-strangnas-gorsingeberget-20260508.html, stamped 'Senast uppdaterad: 5 juni 2025') shows the Brookfield and FAQ text unchanged except one verb tense; the September edit added an unrelated sustainable-building section. The statements are therefore June 2025 content, not a new observation, and the page's update stamp does not refresh them.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Strängnäs or Brookfield record with new content about the AI centre (land sale completion, plan or permit decision, grid agreement or works).

entries.candidate: Microsoft Espoo Hepokorpi campus (existing record curated:microsoft-finland-espoo-hepokorpi-campus:second-building): contractor bulletin checked
entries.reason: The same main contractor's Espoo bulletin (winthrop.ie/espoo-projectupdates/, local winthrop-espoo-updates.html, sitemap lastmod 25 September 2026) still carries the update dated 03/07/2026 (envelope installation, floor-slab casting, equipment deliveries, interior fit-out, foundations and earthworks underway). That is newer than the existing 11 June 2026 observation but 116 days old, outside the 85-day window, and the September sitemap modification is not a new dated bulletin. The Espoo campus locator is a parcel polygon project locator, so further Espoo buildings could not inherit it either.
entries.reopen_condition: A newly dated Espoo bulletin or Microsoft/Espoo record within the window for the second building.

entries.candidate: Dansk Data Center 1 (DDC1), Esbjerg harbour (existing record curated:dansk-data-center-1-esbjerg-campus:ddc1-current-build): refresh checked
entries.reason: Bravida's release of 18 August 2026 (local bravida-bravida-vinner-installationsuppdrag-pa-nytt-datacenter-i-esbjergs-hamn-i-danmark.html) announces that Bravida was chosen as technical partner for building DDC1 (electrical, HVAC, cooling and building-automation installations), that the project was initiated in August 2026 and is expected in service in autumn 2027. It is a contract award, not an observation of physical work newer than the existing 13 August 2026 construction record, so it is not used as a refresh.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated CIP, Thylander, PensionDanmark, Plexar, Bravida or Esbjerg record of the DDC1 works' progress after 13 August 2026.

entries.candidate: Ryhti permit 302406693L on property 257-483-2-126, Kirkkonummi, as identity/scope context for the Microsoft Kirkkonummi Second Datacenter Building (removed by verifier)
entries.reason: Verifier (worker 1, 27 October 2026) removed the Ryhti record (ryhti-property-257-483-2-126-kirkkonummi.json, sha256 2ca98bd2...) as a context source of the second-building addition. Ryhti records two 29,095 m2 buildings under permit 302406693L with a recorded construction start of 18 March 2026, but the contractor's 19 February 2026 bulletin (Internet Archive copy of 15 May 2026) already reports steel frames, facade, roofing and interior finishing on the data-centre hall, so the permit's two buildings cannot be shown to be the first and second data centre buildings, and which permit building (if either) is the second building is not published. The addition stands on the contractor bulletin and the inherited campus locator without this context.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated Microsoft, contractor or Kirkkonummi building-control record that assigns permit 302406693L (or a named Ryhti building) to the first or second data centre building of the Kirkkonummi campus.
